title: Evaluating Spiking MoveNet Deployability for Near-Future Onboard Spiking Satellite Pose Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: SNNs are attracting interest due to their potential for energy efficiency and event-driven processing. However, neuromorphic hardware is not yet mature enough to enable embedded deployment of complex spiking network architectures. In this work, we investigate a spiking version of the MoveNet architecture tailored for autonomous spacecraft operation, aiming to evaluate the deployability of this complex architecture compared to the non-spiking version for embedded, fully event-based solutions in space applications. Using the RAPTOR dataset, we compare the performance and operational cost of the proposed S-MoveNet-Lightning architecture with its standard version, MoveNet-Lightning. Our results show balanced advantages in computational resources and architectural settings for spiking U-Net-like architectures. translated_title: 评估脉冲MoveNet在近期星载脉冲卫星姿态估计中的可部署性
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）因其能效潜力和事件驱动处理能力而受到关注。然而，神经形态硬件尚未成熟到足以实现复杂脉冲网络架构的嵌入式部署。在这项工作中，我们研究了一种为自主航天器运行而定制的MoveNet架构脉冲版本，旨在与与非脉冲版本相比，评估这种复杂架构在空间应用中嵌入式、完全事件驱动解决方案的可部署性。使用RAPTOR数据集，我们将所提出的S-MoveNet-Lightning架构的性能和运行成本与其标准版本MoveNet-Lightning进行了比较。我们的结果表明，脉冲式U-Net类架构在计算资源和架构设置方面具有均衡的优势。对所提出的用于姿态估计的脉冲神经网络（SNN）方法的性能和硬件占用的评估显示……
tldr: 该研究提出一种面向自主航天器运行的脉冲版MoveNet架构（S-MoveNet-Lightning），并通过在RAPTOR数据集上与标准版本的对比，评估了复杂脉冲神经网络在空间应用中嵌入式全事件驱动部署的可行性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a spiking version of the MoveNet architecture (S-MoveNet-Lightning) for autonomous spacecraft operation and evaluates its deployability for embedded, fully event-based space applications by comparing it with the standard version on the RAPTOR dataset.
